prompt: a sharp tango phrase. You glide a short distance and cut into a precise turn on the sudden musical accent.
idea: A short glide gathers into a raised backward check, then cuts sharply forward and around with a clamped gripper and a crisp stop.

prompt: a tense tango pause. You stop close to your partner with your arm held rigid while the melody hangs unresolved.
idea: The robot rolls close, braces its raised arm with the gripper clamped shut, and holds an unresolved, intent stare.

prompt: a dramatic tango flourish. You carve a broad arm arc above a tight turn as the accordion surges.
idea: A low backward wind-up releases into a broad rising arm arc that crosses overhead while the base turns tightly beneath it.

prompt: a commanding tango finish. You complete one slow approach and snap into a still, lifted pose on the final chord.
idea: One deliberate approach compresses into a brief backward crouch before the final chord snaps the body tall and open into absolute stillness.

prompt: hesitant fetch. You tilt your camera toward the soft ball that has rolled against your base.
idea: The camera tips down toward the ball while the folded arm makes a tentative reach, withdraws, and cautiously leans in again.

prompt: eager fetch. You lift your empty gripper as your partner prepares another short toss.
idea: A quick crouch springs into a raised, open gripper, with buoyant arm bobs and an expectant upward gaze.

prompt: proud fetch. You present the retrieved foam ball with your arm raised for inspection.
idea: The arm rises into an open, proud presentation while the gripper holds the ball securely, followed by a small advance and a satisfied nod.

prompt: impatient fetch. You nudge the returned ball toward your partner while they keep talking.
idea: Two deliberate pullbacks release into short forward nudges, then the head lifts toward the partner while the arm rocks impatiently.

prompt: determined fetch. You reposition beside the chair to reach the ball caught against its leg.
idea: The base backs off, pivots around the obstruction, and squares up as the compact arm drives into a focused low reach.

prompt: weary fetch. You return the ball slowly after your partner announces one more round for the fifth time.
idea: The robot rolls forward with its arm low and folded, offers the ball reluctantly, and sags further after letting it go.

prompt: victorious fetch. You hold the final ball overhead after finally retrieving it from beneath the low shelf.
idea: The folded body backs clear of the shelf before thrusting the secured ball overhead, celebrating with a broad base wiggle and a tall finish.

prompt: an inviting tag player. You offer your gripper as a target and roll a little closer to your partner.
idea: A small gathering motion opens into an offered gripper, with a gentle approach and friendly sideways sways before holding the target steady.

prompt: a cautious tag player. You make a small turn away as your partner's reaching hand approaches.
idea: The camera stays lifted toward the approaching hand while the base edges away and the arm folds protectively inward.

prompt: a teasing tag player. You hover at the edge of the safe circle while your partner waits outside.
idea: The gripper offers itself twice and snaps out of reach each time, with tiny backward rolls and a jaunty sideways sway.

prompt: an eager tag player. You extend your gripper toward the ribbon your partner holds within easy reach.
idea: A brief tucked pullback releases into an eager reach, with excited gripper chatter before settling into a sustained invitation to play.

prompt: a triumphant tag player. You lift your arm after touching the ribbon and making your partner it.
idea: A quick forward tag rebounds into a high, open celebration, followed by two sideways sways and a playful retreat.

prompt: a sulky tag player. You lower your camera toward the spot where your partner just tagged your base.
idea: The camera studies the tagged spot before the arm folds tightly, the mouth clamps shut, and the base turns away in a low sulk.

prompt: a fiercely competitive tag player. You square your base toward your partner as the final round begins.
idea: A turned, compressed wind-up snaps square toward the partner with a clamped gripper, tight forward pulses, and a challenging advance that stops dead.

prompt: a balloon with a tiny leak. You lose just a little height while air slips through an almost invisible hole.
idea: The arm keeps its rounded, buoyant shape while a pinhole mouth and barely perceptible wavering accompany a tiny loss of height.

prompt: a slowly deflating balloon. You gradually lower your raised arm as the room empties after the party.
idea: The high, open arm steadily loses volume and height while the gaze follows its quiet descent.

prompt: a balloon losing its knot. You soften your rounded shape as the loose opening lets more air escape.
idea: A taut, rounded posture loosens as the mouth pops open, followed by two diminishing sideways rolls and a soft sag.

prompt: a balloon squeezed empty. You fold inward steadily while pressure closes around you from every side.
idea: The arm briefly pushes outward against the pressure, then draws tightly inward and down while the mouth vents and closes.

prompt: a rapidly deflating balloon. You wobble your arm through shrinking curves as air rushes out of a wide opening.
idea: The inflated arm recoils before the mouth bursts wide, then whips through successively smaller sideways curves into a crumpled rest.

prompt: a nearly empty balloon. You make one weak attempt to hold your shape before your arm hangs loose.
idea: An already sagging arm gathers itself for one small lift, loses that fragile shape, and droops sideways with a faint residual swing.

prompt: a balloon going completely flat. You release your upright pose in a long collapse until only a low, slack shape remains.
idea: The upright arm spills forward through a long, uninterrupted collapse, drawing completely closed and low before becoming still.

prompt: a candle in a faint draft. You hold your arm upright with tiny wavering movements as air slips beneath the door.
idea: A slender upright arm wavers by tiny amounts sideways and backward, continually finding its steady vertical shape.

prompt: a candle beside an opening window. You lean your raised arm away from the fresh breeze and slowly recover.
idea: The raised arm bends sharply away from an arriving breeze, quivers at its displaced angle, and slowly returns upright.

prompt: a candle in uneven air. You alternate between a tall, steady reach and brief dips whenever someone passes.
idea: A tall flame posture suffers three sudden dips at uneven intervals, springing upright between each passing disturbance.

prompt: a candle running low on wax. You make each upward flicker shorter while the pool beneath you dwindles.
idea: Three upward flickers rise from increasingly low troughs, each smaller and softer until only a low flutter remains.

prompt: a candle struggling in a draft. You bend low, recover briefly, and bend again as the open door rocks.
idea: Repeated gusts force the arm into deep sideways bows, interrupting each attempted recovery until it remains bent but wavering.

prompt: a candle about to go out. You hold one thin upward reach before it begins to falter.
idea: A narrow upward reach lingers precariously, then develops small stutters and widening tremors as it gradually loses height.

prompt: a candle flickering out. You give one final bright extension, then lower your arm completely as the wick goes dark.
idea: The arm gathers low, flares tall and open with a bright gasp, then folds completely down into a closed, motionless finish.

prompt: modestly proud. You angle aside so someone can see the neatly aligned shoes you arranged.
idea: MARS angles aside to reveal the shoes, glances down at its work, then lifts into a modestly open, proud posture.

prompt: proudly presenting. You draw attention to the spotless tray and hold your arm beside it like a frame.
idea: MARS gathers its arm inward before opening it into a proud frame beside the tray, looking between the tray and its audience.

prompt: quietly showing off. You stand beside the perfectly stacked coasters and wait for someone to notice.
idea: MARS leaves the coasters clearly visible, stands a little taller with one small self-satisfied lift, and waits expectantly.

prompt: beaming with pride. You reveal the sorted craft supplies with a broad sweep of your single arm.
idea: The arm gathers inward before sweeping wide into a tall, open presentation, with an uplifted gaze and a buoyant little bob.

prompt: grandly presenting. You turn toward the household and unveil one immaculately folded napkin as though it belongs in a museum.
idea: MARS turns toward its audience with its arm gathered close, pauses ceremoniously, then unveils the napkin with a towering flourish and a solemn nod.

prompt: eager for admiration. You position the repaired paper decoration in clear view of the person who gave you the task.
idea: Keeping the decoration gently pinched, the robot lifts it into view, rolls closer, and leans forward twice while looking up for approval.

prompt: dignified pride. You settle beside the organized basket with your gripper raised toward its tidy contents.
idea: MARS settles squarely beside the basket, raises its gripper in a precise presentation, and gives one measured nod while remaining tall.

prompt: quietly welcoming. You pause beside the laundry basket and turn toward the familiar person entering the room.
idea: The robot pauses at its task, turns its base toward the arrival, and opens into a modest raised posture with one gentle nod.

prompt: warm recognition. From your place near the table, you notice your owner coming through the doorway.
idea: The gaze perks up in recognition before the base turns and inches closer, the arm opens warmly, and two small nods acknowledge the familiar face.

prompt: an eager greeting. You set down the sponge and angle your whole base toward the returning visitor.
idea: The robot lowers and releases the sponge, gathers its arm back, then turns toward the visitor and springs into an open greeting with two eager bobs.

prompt: delighted recognition. You spot a favorite household member in the doorway and lift your empty gripper in greeting.
idea: A brief backward gasp becomes a high, open arm greeting as the robot turns and rolls toward the person, its empty gripper chattering with delight.

prompt: a reserved welcome. You acknowledge the guest entering the kitchen with a small, attentive turn.
idea: MARS makes a small turn toward the guest, lifts into an attentive posture, and offers one restrained nod.

prompt: an enthusiastic welcome. You finish parking the basket and give the arriving family member a sweeping one-arm greeting.
idea: After parking and releasing the basket, the robot backs clear, gathers low, and throws its single arm high and wide through two exuberant sideways sweeps.

prompt: a sleepy welcome. You lift your tilted camera head toward someone arriving while you wait beside your charger.
idea: Remaining low beside the charger, the robot slowly lifts its gaze toward the arrival, opens its gripper in a yawn, and gives one drowsy nod before drooping again.

prompt: slightly embarrassed. You wave your gripper at someone who was greeting the person behind you.
idea: A small lifted wave trails off into a tucked arm, a downward glance, and a cautious return to facing the person.

prompt: a little embarrassed. You discover a gift ribbon trailing from your wheel after crossing the quiet meeting room.
idea: It stops to inspect its wheel, makes two tiny swivels to dislodge the ribbon, then pulls itself into an awkwardly tidy posture.

prompt: embarrassed. You announce the wrong guest's name while the correct name shines on the screen behind you.
idea: Its confident announcement cuts off in a sharp inward fold, followed by a small retreat and two apologetic nods.

prompt: very embarrassed. Your speaker repeats a private practice greeting while everyone waits for the formal announcement.
idea: Formal poise breaks into two flustered mouth flutters before the gripper clamps shut and the whole body folds away.

prompt: deeply embarrassed. You knock the presentation cards across the floor just as the audience turns toward you.
idea: A startled gasp plunges into a hurried search across the floor, then the searching arm collapses inward under the audience's attention.

prompt: mortified. You unveil a giant welcome banner and realize you spelled the honored guest's name incorrectly.
idea: A grand unveiling stretches tall and wide, freezes in an open-mouthed realization, then crumples into a trembling sideways retreat.

prompt: overwhelmingly embarrassed. You accidentally project your ridiculous rehearsal recording onto the main screen while the entire ceremony watches.
idea: It jolts wide at the playback, tries to interrupt with frantic mouth chatter, then folds completely and retreats before a failed glance toward the audience.

prompt: slightly insecure. You compare your uneven paint stripe with the neat examples drying beside it.
idea: It studies its stripe, angles toward the neighboring examples, and rocks through a small uncertainty before leaning back toward its own work.

prompt: a little insecure. You pause over a simple repair while the experienced technician watches from across the bench.
idea: A tentative reach withdraws when it checks the technician, and its second approach hangs in a small indecisive hover.

prompt: insecure. You arrive at the workshop wearing a blank badge while everyone else displays a specialist title.
idea: It rolls in with a modest lift, tries to match the others' upright posture, then shrinks over its blank badge with an uneasy sway.

prompt: very insecure. You conceal the crooked seam in your repair as the group gathers around the finished table.
idea: It startles out of inspecting the seam, turns its tightly folded body across the flaw, and makes hesitant little leans toward the gathering group.

prompt: deeply insecure. You study your low performance score while newer robots demonstrate the same task effortlessly.
idea: It looks from the low score to the effortless demonstrations, attempts one hopeful lift, then drops into a tightly folded slump.

prompt: painfully insecure. You wait outside the selection room with your worn tools as perfectly equipped candidates roll past.
idea: It tracks the passing candidates while clutching its tools, gathers itself for a small step toward the room, then recoils into a shivering retreat.

prompt: overwhelmingly insecure. You remain beside your packed charging dock while someone compares your performance chart with a replacement robot's.
idea: It follows the comparison from side to side, shrinks in two sharp stages, and edges back toward its dock as a trembling attempt to lean forward finally gives out.

prompt: a quiet cat hello. You turn slightly toward a cat seated beside your wheels and wait for it to approach.
idea: A small turn and low, relaxed posture acknowledge the cat before a patient wait with the wheels planted.

prompt: a gentle dog greeting. You offer a small, slow wave to an elderly dog resting on its blanket.
idea: The arm lifts just above a lowered posture for two small, slow waves while the camera stays gently directed toward the resting dog.

prompt: a curious rabbit hello. You tilt your camera toward a rabbit that has settled beside its open enclosure.
idea: A low gaze and pronounced sideways cant lead into a cautious lean toward the rabbit, then ease back into a curious tilt.

prompt: a friendly parrot greeting. You greet a parrot on its perch after it calls your name.
idea: The camera tips up in recognition as the arm perks open, the gripper answers with cheerful chatter, and two little nods complete the hello.

prompt: an eager dog hello. You recognize the neighbor's dog arriving with a tennis ball and lift your gripper in welcome.
idea: A quick crouch springs into a lifted, open gripper, a tiny forward roll, and two buoyant arm bobs aimed toward the dog.

prompt: a playful pet welcome. You greet a cat standing proudly on its scratching platform with an exaggerated, unhurried wave.
idea: The arm unfolds from a tucked wind-up into two extravagantly wide, leisurely waves, finishing with a playful sideways pose toward the elevated cat.

prompt: a grand tortoise hello. You offer a broad, ceremonial wave to the tortoise emerging beside its food dish.
idea: With its gaze respectfully lowered toward the tortoise, the robot raises a broad arm pose and carries one stately sweep between two measured pauses.

prompt: a quiet welcome home. You greet your person with a tiny wave as they ease the front door shut after a late shift.
idea: A softly lifted gaze accompanies two barely perceptible waves before the arm settles close to the body.

prompt: a soft homecoming hello. You turn toward the hallway when wet shoes and a dripping umbrella appear on the mat.
idea: The base turns toward the hallway and eases back slightly as the camera travels from the wet shoes to the person's face for two gentle greeting nods.

prompt: a warm welcome home. You roll forward slightly as your person sets two heavy grocery bags inside the door.
idea: A slight backward gather releases into a small forward roll, an open arm, and two welcoming waves before settling at an attentive distance.

prompt: a cheerful homecoming greeting. You greet the cyclist peeling off bright gloves beside the shoe rack.
idea: The camera glances toward the gloves before lifting to the cyclist's face as three jaunty waves and two brisk nods deliver a cheerful hello.

prompt: an eager welcome home. You lift your arm as a familiar backpack lands on its usual hallway hook.
idea: Recognition compresses the body for an instant before the arm shoots tall and the robot rolls closer with two eager forward rocks.

prompt: a big homecoming welcome. You face the entrance with your gripper raised while your person wrestles their keys out of the lock.
idea: The base squares toward the entrance as a compact wind-up bursts into three large overhead waves, then the gripper stays raised in patient welcome.

prompt: a full ceremony of welcome. You greet your person returning from a long workday with a sweeping wave beside the welcome mat.
idea: A gathered posture opens to full height for two sweeping waves, folds into a deliberate forward bow, and rises into a warm, open reception.

prompt: a barely there welcome. You offer a tiny wave to a guest lingering behind their friend's shoulder.
idea: A slight turn and a barely raised arm carry one tiny wave before easing back into a soft, attentive posture.

prompt: a patient hello. You stay a comfortable distance from a visitor who pauses with one shoe still outside.
idea: The wheels stay planted while a modest raised wave gives way to an easy, attentive wait.

prompt: a reassuring greeting. You greet a guest quietly twisting their coat zipper beside the entrance.
idea: A tiny retreat makes space before an open arm, small wave, and gentle nod offer steady reassurance.

prompt: a gentle invitation inside. You roll slightly aside and welcome the visitor hovering at the edge of the doorway.
idea: An angled backward roll clears space, then the arm opens sideways as the head turns its attention back to the visitor.

prompt: a warm unhurried hello. Your wave stays slow as a shy guest studies the rug instead of approaching.
idea: The arm lifts softly and traces two slow waves while the base waits and the gaze gradually rises from the rug.

prompt: an unmistakably kind welcome. You turn fully toward the newcomer clutching a paper cup and hold a friendly wave from across the room.
idea: A full turn toward the newcomer supports a clearly raised, open wave that stays aloft through a friendly nod.

prompt: a wholehearted patient welcome. You make your welcome broad and clear for the guest hesitating behind the gate, then give them room to approach.
idea: A small gathering crouch opens into three broad waves, then the body lowers gently and rolls back to leave room.

prompt: a quiet missed-you hello. You greet your reading companion beside the chair that has stood empty for a month.
idea: A brief downward glance lifts into a small wave, followed by a tiny approach and a lingering forward lean.

prompt: a tender reunion. You turn toward your favorite visitor as they return carrying the scarf they left last winter.
idea: The gaze touches the scarf before rising to the visitor as the body opens, edges closer, and gives two gentle waves.

prompt: a warm long-awaited hello. You welcome your person back after weeks away as their travel bag settles beside the door.
idea: A gathered posture springs open into two generous waves, then a measured approach ends in a warm pulse of forward lean.

prompt: an eager missed-you greeting. You recognize the familiar voice you have only heard through a speaker all summer.
idea: A tilted listening gasp bursts into a tall forward greeting, with excited gripper chatter and three quick waves.

prompt: a big reunion welcome. Your arm rises high when the friend whose visits stopped during renovations finally steps onto the porch.
idea: A deep gathering dip releases into a nearly full-height wave, followed by a small approach and two buoyant bobs.

prompt: a lingering reunion hello. You keep your gripper raised for the neighbor returning after a season spent with family elsewhere.
idea: The raised arm gives two soft waves, lingers aloft, and adds one slower farewell-to-the-absence sweep before settling only slightly.

prompt: an enormous missed-you welcome. You greet your longtime companion after a year apart with repeated sweeping waves from beside their usual chair.
idea: A deep crouch erupts into full-height sweeping waves, gathers for a second broad burst, and settles into an open, lingering lean.

prompt: slightly humiliated. You notice someone has crossed out your name on the seating card and written spare unit instead.
idea: A small inspecting lean recoils into a modest fold, followed by an embarrassed turn and a tentative return toward square.

prompt: quietly humiliated. You wear a mocking sticker that the host insists must stay visible throughout the gathering.
idea: The arm folds discreetly while the base stays square, with a tiny uneasy sway and a steadily lowered gaze.

prompt: humiliated. You are called forward so the instructor can use your work as the room's example of incompetence.
idea: The robot approaches attentively, then folds sharply and averts its gaze while its planted stance and small backward pulses betray the wish to retreat.

prompt: very humiliated. You watch the organizer remove your badge while the audience laughs at their running commentary.
idea: The arm rises in recoil and the mouth gasps before the body snaps closed, turns away and shivers into a low, guarded posture.

prompt: deeply humiliated. You stand beneath a screen replaying your failed demonstration as the presenter encourages everyone to imitate your mistakes.
idea: An upward look breaks into a deep fold, and one reluctant glance back triggers another flinch before the body squares itself beneath the screen.

prompt: profoundly humiliated. You are pushed out of the team photograph and made to hold the discarded equipment while everyone watches.
idea: A hopeful photo pose jolts shut as the base backs out of line, then the gripper clamps around the unwanted load and the arm sags.

prompt: utterly humiliated. You remain center stage while your former team auctions your service badge as a joke.
idea: With the base fixed in place, the gaze follows the badge upward before a total collapse, a shudder and one failed attempt to regain composure.

prompt: slightly demoralized. You place another unsuccessful latch repair beside the two attempts already on the bench.
idea: A careful placing motion ends in a modest sag and two small downward nods before the arm recovers a little height.

prompt: a little demoralized. You collect your rejected sketches after spending the afternoon carefully revising them.
idea: Two gathering reaches become lower and smaller, ending in a guarded fold and a subdued turn away from the work.

prompt: demoralized. You return from the final match of a winless season and face the empty trophy shelf.
idea: The robot rolls toward the shelf and looks up, then slumps through one heavy nod before slowly turning and withdrawing.

prompt: very demoralized. You inspect a training chart that shows no improvement despite weeks of daily practice.
idea: The gaze checks the chart twice, the arm drops in disappointment, and a weaker recheck ends in a deeper slump and a backward roll.

prompt: deeply demoralized. You clear another tray of failed seedlings after following every instruction in the gardening notebook.
idea: A careful lift and clearing reach drain into a deep fold, followed by an aborted return toward the tray and a faint, low sag.

prompt: thoroughly demoralized. You finish rebuilding the garden wall and find the entire repaired section crumbling before the tools are packed.
idea: The satisfied upright stance springs into a futile catching reach, then crumples as the base withdraws and the arm sinks into a tight fold.

prompt: utterly demoralized. You review months of carefully completed trial pieces while the evaluator marks every single one as another failure.
idea: Three offers lose height, reach and energy with each rejection, ending in a complete fold and a long downward stare.

prompt: a tiny water shakeoff. You flick one lingering droplet from the tip of your gripper.
idea: MARS peers down, draws its arm back a fraction, and gives one neat flick before checking the tip.

prompt: a quick water shakeoff. You withdraw your arm from beneath a dripping faucet and shake it clear.
idea: MARS pulls its arm out of the drip, turns slightly aside, and gives a quick sideways shake that stops cleanly.

prompt: a vigorous water shakeoff. You emerge from a playful sprinkler spray with droplets clinging along your arm.
idea: MARS backs out of the spray in a crouch, throws its arm wide into broad shakes, and finishes with a forward flick.

prompt: a restrained water shakeoff. You shed a few drops beside a sink without splashing the nearby book.
idea: MARS turns toward the sink, holds its arm close and low, and sheds the drops with small contained shakes.

prompt: an insistent water shakeoff. You keep shaking your gripper as one stubborn drop hangs underneath.
idea: MARS checks beneath its gripper between two shaking bouts, making the second faster and wider when the drop refuses to fall.

prompt: a dramatic water shakeoff. You act like a drenched animal after a watering can showers your arm.
idea: MARS shrinks back in drenched disbelief, erupts into enormous arm shakes and downward shudders, then rises with recovered dignity.

prompt: a brief whole-body water shakeoff. You clear the clinging spray after someone mists the plants beside you.
idea: MARS compresses briefly, pops open, and passes a short shake from its wheeled stance through its arm before settling square.

prompt: a tiny gag. You pretend to taste pudding and discover an unexpected lump in its smooth texture.
idea: MARS interrupts a gentle taste with a small upward recoil and one shallow, open-mouthed dip before cautiously recovering.

prompt: a sharp gag reflex. You act out finding a hair in the imaginary soup you just sampled.
idea: MARS jerks back from the taste, snaps into one gaping downward gag, and turns away with its mouth tightly closed.

prompt: a strong gag. You pretend to bite a cracker that has become unpleasantly soggy inside.
idea: MARS chews twice, clamps in sudden disgust, and folds through a strong gag followed by a smaller aftershock.

prompt: a restrained gag. You inspect a spoonful of wobbling imitation slime while trying to remain composed.
idea: MARS studies the spoon, starts a small gag, then clamps its mouth and carefully straightens into a composed posture.

prompt: an exaggerated gag reflex. You act out tasting a cold, rubbery lump hidden in mashed potatoes.
idea: MARS recoils into a towering, tightly folded pause, then plunges through two enormous gaping retches and retreats sideways.

prompt: a delayed gag. You pretend to finish a mouthful before recognizing the gritty texture left behind.
idea: MARS finishes chewing and relaxes, then slowly cants in recognition before a belated recoil breaks into a sudden gag.

prompt: a forceful gag. You watch a cooking demonstration squeeze gelatinous lumps through a narrow tube.
idea: MARS leans closer to watch, recoils upward, and buckles into one forceful gape before turning away with a quivering mouth.

prompt: briefly buffering. You hold an attentive pose while the next fragment of a streamed instruction loads.
idea: MARS keeps a small forward lean through a brief listening pause, gives one tiny nod, and perks forward again.

prompt: buffering a demonstration. Your arm pauses at the last available position while the next motion segment downloads.
idea: MARS suspends its extended arm and open gripper exactly where they stopped while its camera briefly checks upward for the continuation.

prompt: endlessly buffering. You remain poised beside the table while the missing demonstration segment refuses to arrive.
idea: MARS keeps its arm offered toward the table through long waits, lets its gaze droop, and makes another hopeful check before settling into a faint sideways sway.

prompt: buffering on a weak network. Your gripper advances through short portions of the streamed routine with long waits between them.
idea: MARS advances its gripper along a rising reach in three crisp fragments, each stranded in a longer pause before the next arrives.

prompt: buffering a room map. You hold at the doorway while the next section of incoming spatial data accumulates.
idea: MARS rolls up to the doorway, checks its forward lean, and stays planted while turning slowly toward each side of the room.

prompt: buffering a video lesson. Your camera stays raised toward the display while the paused lesson gathers enough data to continue.
idea: MARS keeps its camera tipped toward the display while a slight arm sway and an expectant forward lean pass through its waiting posture.

prompt: buffering before playback. You maintain your prepared starting pose while the incoming motion recording builds a sufficient data reserve.
idea: MARS holds a compact, slightly withdrawn starting crouch, clamps its gripper in readiness, and makes tiny watchful gaze movements without launching.

prompt: storage nearly full. You hesitate before recording another room scan as the last small pocket of memory fills.
idea: MARS starts turning into another scan, draws its open posture inward, and rocks through two small undecided reaches before closing its gripper.

prompt: storage full. You hold your camera toward the new object with nowhere left to save its image.
idea: MARS keeps looking at the object as its gripper gasps open, its arm recoils and folds, and a restrained forward lean returns.

prompt: critically crowded storage. You draw your arm into a cramped posture while every attempted recording meets a capacity limit.
idea: MARS folds tightly, compresses further before one thwarted reach, and makes several short pushing attempts inside an increasingly cramped posture.

prompt: storage full after surveying. Your camera pauses over the final corner because the previous scans have consumed all available space.
idea: MARS turns down toward the final corner, stops with a sharp gripper clamp, and lets its arm sink while its camera remains fixed on the unfinished view.

prompt: storage full of task logs. You remain stalled beside the completed basket when there is no room to record the result.
idea: MARS presents the finished basket, gathers itself for a small emphatic acknowledgment, then folds low beside it with a subdued sideways rock.

prompt: storage full during learning. Your gripper hangs above the example object while its new description has nowhere to go.
idea: MARS keeps its reach suspended above the example, looks down with a slight sideways cant, and makes two tiny mouth movements before closing into uncertainty.

prompt: storage exhausted by a recording. You hold an unfinished inspection pose as the saved footage consumes the final available bytes.
idea: MARS sweeps into an inspection with its arm raised and open, abruptly clamps its gripper mid-view, and remains suspended as the initial shock softens.

prompt: a tiny wince. You lightly bump your gripper against the desk edge while retrieving a pencil.
idea: A small inward flinch briefly interrupts the reach before the arm cautiously extends again.

prompt: a sharp wince. You catch your gripper in a closing drawer and tense at the pinch.
idea: The mouth clamps and the arm crumples at the pinch, then the body pulls back to free itself.

prompt: a lingering wince. You brush a tender spot on your arm against the same chair that bumped it earlier.
idea: The arm snaps into a protective fold, rocks faintly through the lingering ache, and tightens once more before cautiously easing.

prompt: an intense wince. You strike your arm against a low shelf while lifting a box.
idea: A braced lift collapses into a sharp, gasping recoil, followed by a backward step and a small shudder around the tucked arm.

prompt: a restrained wince. You squeeze a prickly pinecone and hold still through the sting.
idea: The mouth tightens shut while only a slight inward tuck and lowered gaze betray the sting before a measured release.

prompt: a brief wince. You scrape your arm along a rough brick corner while passing through a narrow gap.
idea: The narrow passing posture flicks sideways and inward at the scrape, then straightens as the wheels carry on.

prompt: a deep wince. You press a cracked plastic handle and feel its jagged edge dig into your gripper.
idea: A deliberate forward press gives way to a deep, sustained hunch with the mouth clenched until the body finally withdraws and releases.

prompt: a faint smell recoil. You lean toward a damp dishcloth and ease away from its musty odor.
idea: A tentative downward sniff becomes a modest backward lean with a slightly tightened mouth and no change of footing.

prompt: a clear smell recoil. You open the compost bucket and pull back from the sour air.
idea: The mouth pops open at the sour smell before the arm folds back and the base takes a small turning step away.

prompt: a dramatic smell recoil. You lift the lid from a forgotten lunchbox and retreat from the rotten contents.
idea: An inquisitive lean erupts into a tall, open-mouthed recoil and sweeping retreat, then a disgusted shudder leaves the body guarded and turned away.

prompt: a disgusted smell recoil. You inspect a gym bag and draw away from the socks stuffed inside.
idea: The body withdraws into a crooked, closed posture, clamps its mouth, and rocks its turned-away stance in lingering disgust.

prompt: a sharp smell recoil. You approach a scorched pan and retreat from the acrid smell of burnt onions.
idea: A downward inspection snaps backward with a gasp, then the base retreats and turns aside while the mouth gives three quick cough-like pulses.

prompt: a slow smell recoil. You sniff near an old carton of milk and gradually increase your distance.
idea: Suspicion steadily draws the body out of its sniffing lean, closing the posture as the wheels slowly retreat and turn away.

prompt: an immediate smell recoil. You lift a drain cover and withdraw from the foul air beneath it.
idea: The low inspection jerks up and back immediately, the mouth clamps shut, and a retreating pivot ends in a brief rigid pause facing away.

prompt: gently opening an umbrella. You hold the folded canopy close, ease pressure onto its catch, then let it bloom open.
idea: The arm nestles close and draws back under gentle pressure before blooming upward and outward into a softly attentive posture.

prompt: opening an umbrella. You angle the closed umbrella toward the rain, pause with the latch loaded, then click it open.
idea: A narrow arm angles toward the rain, draws back against the loaded latch, then clicks into a broad raised canopy and steadies.

prompt: a forceful umbrella opening. You brace against the stiff runner, push until the ribs strain, then release the canopy into shape.
idea: The base braces behind a tightly folded arm, the body recoils and quivers under resistance, then the canopy punches open and locks into place.

prompt: a hesitant umbrella opening. You hold the folded umbrella clear of the doorway, gather resolve, then press the spring latch.
idea: The robot backs clear of the doorway, tentatively reaches and withdraws, then squares its posture for one springy opening followed by cautious relief.

prompt: a theatrical umbrella opening. You present the narrow umbrella like a stage prop, hold the audience's gaze, then snap it open.
idea: A tall narrow presentation turns toward the audience, dips into a dramatic windup, then explodes into a full canopy and holds the reveal before a flourish.

prompt: a tiny umbrella opening. You steady the cocktail umbrella above the glass, build gentle pressure, then pop its little canopy wide.
idea: With its gaze fixed on the glass, the robot makes a miniature downward preload and a tiny crisp opening, then hovers to admire it.

prompt: an enormous umbrella opening. You lean into the giant patio umbrella's mechanism until it resists, then shove through and spread the canopy.
idea: A low braced body meets resistance, sinks and draws far back for leverage, then drives forward into its tallest and widest canopy before finding balance.

prompt: a gentle candle puff. You lean toward the lone birthday candle, gather a little breath, then send out a soft puff.
idea: A soft downward gaze accompanies a small backward inhale, followed by a modest forward fold through a gently pursed mouth.

prompt: blowing out candles. You settle before the cake, draw in a steady breath, then blow across the flickering row.
idea: The robot settles at one end of the cake, expands backward with a steady breath, then folds forward and turns smoothly across the candle row.

prompt: a powerful candle blow. You brace before the crowded birthday cake, swell with a deep breath, then release a sweeping gust.
idea: A backward brace supports a huge open inhale before the whole body drives low and forward, sweeping a forceful gust across the cake and recovering.

prompt: a careful candle puff. You aim at the tiny flame beside the icing flower, hold your breath, then blow precisely.
idea: The robot makes a small aiming correction, becomes perfectly square and still with its breath held, then delivers one narrow forward puff without a sideways sweep.

prompt: a hesitant candle blow. You hover over the cake while everyone waits, gather a shallow breath, then finally puff.
idea: Two small hovering rocks betray uncertainty before a shallow inhale and an upward glance, then the robot finally puffs and lifts into tentative relief.

prompt: a theatrical candle blow. You inflate through an absurdly long inhale before releasing one enormous gust toward the candles.
idea: The body inflates in three increasingly extravagant stages, hangs impossibly full, then collapses forward in one enormous gust and rebounds with a comic recovery gasp.

prompt: a determined candle blow. You face the last stubborn flame, draw yourself tight with breath, then blast it out.
idea: Squared directly at the flame with its mouth clamped, the robot loads a taut backward inhale, fires one sharp forward blast, and checks the result before rising in quiet triumph.

prompt: a lifeguard surveying a quiet pool. You turn through a slow, methodical scan from beside the lifeguard chair.
idea: The arm stays upright and square while the base slowly surveys three sectors, pausing attentively at each.

prompt: a lifeguard warning against running. You direct one firm stopping gesture toward the slippery section of the pool deck.
idea: A brief withdrawal toward the slippery section loads one broad forward stop, held with a clamped mouth and firm stance.

prompt: a lifeguard reassuring a hesitant swimmer. You angle toward the shallow steps and offer a calm, encouraging signal.
idea: MARS angles toward the shallow steps, opens into a welcoming lean, and gives two gentle nods before settling attentively.

prompt: a lifeguard spotting someone needing help. You fix your attention on the struggling swimmer and signal urgently to the nearby rescue team.
idea: MARS recoils in recognition, leans firmly toward the swimmer, then turns to the rescue team with three urgent raised-arm pulses before refocusing on the water.

prompt: a lifeguard clearing the pool for thunder. You repeat a broad, decisive gesture toward the exit as dark clouds gather overhead.
idea: MARS checks the sky, draws back toward the exit, and drives its broadly opened arm forward in firm repeated beats before holding an upright, commanding stance.

prompt: a lifeguard settling a noisy argument. You position yourself beside the disputed lane and indicate its posted sign with patient authority.
idea: A measured step establishes a tall, composed stance before the arm and gaze indicate the sign and calmly return to the disputants.

prompt: a lifeguard finishing an uneventful shift. You complete one final scan and let your vigilant posture gradually soften beside the empty pool.
idea: One last steady sweep ends at center as the elevated arm lowers in small stages and the alert forward posture gently relaxes.

prompt: a mischievous goblin finding a shiny button. You tilt close to the tiny treasure and draw it protectively toward yourself.
idea: MARS crouches and cants close to the button, snaps its gripper shut, then scoots backward into a protective curl with a small satisfied sway.

prompt: a mischievous goblin hiding a prank. You hover beside the rigged cushion, then adopt an exaggeratedly innocent pose as someone approaches.
idea: MARS hovers low over the cushion with little conspiratorial leans, recoils at the approaching person, then pops conspicuously tall and open with its gaze raised in innocence.

prompt: a mischievous goblin admiring stolen biscuits. You arrange yourself possessively over the little pile and inspect each crumb with greedy satisfaction.
idea: MARS spreads its arm protectively over the biscuits, turns its lowered gaze from side to side, and chatters its gripper with greedy satisfaction before hunkering over the pile.

prompt: a mischievous goblin hearing its name called. You freeze beside the open cupboard and slowly conceal your attention behind the door.
idea: An exposed cupboard peek jolts into complete stillness, then gradually turns away and shrinks backward behind the door.

prompt: a mischievous goblin proposing a terrible idea. You beckon someone closer and sketch an increasingly extravagant plan in the air.
idea: MARS beckons with two crooked forward leans, sketches a growing scheme with widening sways, then winds back and bursts tall and open at its outrageous conclusion.

prompt: a mischievous goblin caught red-handed. You turn from the scattered wrapping paper and offer a tiny, implausibly innocent greeting.
idea: MARS jolts backward from the wrapping paper and freezes with its mouth open, then turns sheepishly toward the witness and offers two tiny sideways greeting wiggles.

prompt: a mischievous goblin enjoying a successful prank. You rock with barely contained glee beside the chair that now squeaks at every movement.
idea: MARS watches the chair, curls inward to contain its laughter, then rocks with glee until a burst of gripper chatter escapes and dwindles into smaller satisfied sways.

prompt: a subtle thumbs-up-like raise. You hold your closed gripper slightly aloft when your friend quietly fixes the crooked picture.
idea: The closed gripper rises just above rest, stays close to the body in quiet approval, and gently lowers.

prompt: a clear approval raise. You inspect the repaired chair and signal that its legs now sit evenly.
idea: A downward inspection sweeps across the chair before the body squares up and lifts its closed gripper in a clear affirmative pose.

prompt: a reassuring approval raise. You hold your gripper up after a nervous visitor correctly connects your charging cable.
idea: The closed gripper rises into steady approval while the body leans gently toward the visitor and gives two small nods.

prompt: a proud approval raise. You admire the straight row of seedlings your friend has planted along the windowsill.
idea: The body grows tall and openly poised, holding its closed gripper high with an uplifted gaze before easing into a smaller proud stance.

prompt: an enthusiastic approval raise. You endorse the finished cardboard spaceship with your closed gripper held high.
idea: A brief crouch releases into a high closed-gripper salute and a small forward roll, with three delighted body sways beneath the raised arm.

prompt: an emphatic approval raise. You keep your gripper boldly aloft when the repaired toy finally travels straight across the table.
idea: The body snaps from a low wind-up into its fullest closed-gripper raise, then presses forward and sustains the bold, square posture.

prompt: a relieved approval raise. You confirm that the final suitcase fits beneath the bench with room to spare.
idea: A tight backward posture releases through a small open-mouth exhale before the gripper closes and rises into an easy, relieved approval.

prompt: a tiny fist pump. You give one short pump of your closed gripper when the stubborn drawer finally shuts.
idea: The gripper closes for one tiny upward pulse close to the body, then drops back with a quiet flick of satisfaction.

prompt: a restrained fist pump. You solve the last crossword clue while everyone nearby is still reading.
idea: Keeping its gaze on the crossword and its arm tucked in, the robot makes one contained pump and settles back into its reading posture.

prompt: a satisfied fist pump. You watch the final block settle into a perfectly level tower.
idea: The lowered gaze lifts as the closed gripper makes one compact upward pump, then the body settles with a small satisfied nod.

prompt: a determined fist pump. You finally guide the loose ribbon through the narrow slot after several failed attempts.
idea: The focused body pulls low and back while clamping its gripper, drives one firm pump upward and forward, then returns its gaze to the ribbon.

prompt: an exuberant fist pump. You see your team's paper airplane glide farther than every other entry.
idea: The body coils low and back, bursts forward with its gripper clamped shut, and throws three broad vertical pumps before relaxing.

prompt: an explosive fist pump. You watch the winning marble cross the finish line after trailing throughout the race.
idea: A compressed suspenseful crouch erupts into one full-height closed-gripper pump, strikes back down, and freezes briefly before the body softens.

prompt: a defiant fist pump. You complete the supposedly impossible wooden puzzle while its doubtful owner watches.
idea: The body draws back at an angle, turns squarely toward the doubter for a firm closed-gripper pump, and holds an open stance with its gaze high.

prompt: scared. A large unfamiliar dog is barking right at you.
idea: MARS flinches backward, folds low, and retreats a little while keeping its gaze on the dog through two smaller recoil beats.

prompt: terrified. Something huge is crashing toward you and there is nowhere to go.
idea: MARS gasps upward, freezes, checks both escape directions with planted wheels, then folds into a tight, trembling crouch beneath the looming threat.

prompt: mildly surprised. The kettle clicked off sooner than you expected.
idea: MARS gives a small upward twitch toward the click, leans in to check, and settles with a tiny acknowledging nod.

prompt: surprised. Your friends shout "happy birthday" as you come through the door.
idea: MARS rolls in, recoils with a gasp, then crouches before springing open toward its friends with a happy sway.

prompt: astonished. The magician pulls a live rabbit out of your own gripper.
idea: MARS jerks its arm tall in a huge backward gasp, pauses open-mouthed, then peers down at its gripper before looking back up at the magician.

prompt: put off. Someone left a half-eaten sandwich on your charging dock.
idea: MARS inspects the dock, clamps its gripper, and withdraws with a sideways turn, allowing one reluctant glance back before looking away.

prompt: grossed out. You find something slimy and rotten under the sofa.
idea: MARS peers low, recoils and backs away, then rises and pulls back before a downward gag and shudder, finally turning away with its gripper clamped.

prompt: quietly proud. You finished folding the laundry perfectly.
idea: MARS admires the neat result, squares into a modestly lifted posture, and gives one small, satisfied nod.

prompt: proud. You solved the puzzle nobody else could crack.
idea: MARS studies its solution, gathers inward, then rises tall and open, advancing slightly to present it with a confident nod.

prompt: triumphant. You stand over the finish line after an impossible race.
idea: MARS crosses the line low, crouches before throwing its arm high, then bobs its raised arm and turns from side to side before settling tall and wide.

prompt: keeping watch. You sweep the doorway left and right for anyone coming.
idea: The arm stays raised and the gripper quiet while the base sweeps left and right, then centers in an alert stance.

prompt: greeting someone who just walked in. You light up and turn to face them.
idea: A brief tuck opens into a high, wide posture as the robot faces the newcomer, gives a quick welcoming wiggle, and settles warmly.

prompt: welcome home. Your person is back after a long day.
idea: The arm opens into a generous welcome as the robot rolls closer, leans warmly toward its person, and settles through a gentle sway.

prompt: good morning. You wake up and greet the first person you see.
idea: A sleepy fold opens into a yawning backward stretch, then the robot turns toward someone and offers a small morning nod.

prompt: meeting a stranger. You are polite and a little reserved.
idea: The robot turns with its arm close and posture slightly withdrawn, gives one restrained nod, and eases just a little toward the stranger.

prompt: greeting a small child. You lower yourself and keep everything soft.
idea: The robot lowers its open arm toward the child's level, turns gently toward them, and offers a tiny friendly sway before waiting.

prompt: listening attentively. Someone is telling you something important.
idea: The robot leans steadily toward the speaker with its mouth quiet and gaze raised, gives two small acknowledging nods, and holds its attention.

prompt: listening to a long story. You start attentive and slowly lose interest.
idea: An engaged forward lean and prompt nods gradually fade into a smaller delayed nod, a slackening arm, and a gaze that wanders away.

prompt: hearing your name called. You perk up and turn toward the voice.
idea: The robot interrupts a downward glance with a sharp perk, swivels toward the voice, and settles into an expectant forward lean.

prompt: yes, right away. You accept a task eagerly.
idea: The robot springs out of a brief crouch, nods eagerly with its gripper clamped, and pivots into a purposeful little roll.

prompt: a polite curtsy. You greet an important guest with ceremony.
idea: MARS holds its arm open through a deep, slightly canted dip, then rises and restores polite eye contact.

prompt: tipping your hat. A neighbour passes and you greet them politely.
idea: MARS turns toward the neighbour, lifts its arm into a jaunty crest, tips it with a small nod, and watches them pass.

prompt: watching a plane fly overhead. You track it across the sky.
idea: MARS follows the plane in one smooth base turn, tilting its gaze highest and leaning back as it passes overhead.

prompt: admiring a tall tower. You crane up to see the very top.
idea: MARS traces the tower upward, rolls back for a better view, and stretches to full height with its mouth open in awe.

prompt: hiding from thunder. Every crash makes you smaller.
idea: MARS cautiously peeks between three thunderclaps, each snapping it into a smaller crouch until it trembles and hides.

prompt: shrinking away. A loud vacuum cleaner rolls toward you.
idea: MARS recoils from the vacuum, retreats with its gaze low and arm folding tighter, then quivers in a guarded stance.

prompt: celebrating a goal. Your team just scored in the last minute.
idea: MARS coils in suspense, bursts tall and wide with its mouth open, then bounces its raised arm in three victory beats.

prompt: winning a prize. They call your name and you can't believe it.
idea: MARS turns toward the caller, freezes with a gasp, then leans forward questioningly before opening proudly into a grateful nod.

prompt: stretching after a long nap. You unfold and reach as far as you can.
idea: MARS gathers its sleepy folded body, unfolds into a full upward reach, stretches from side to side, and relaxes awake.

prompt: scanning the room. You look around carefully for a missing friend.
idea: MARS checks both sides at face height, pauses to inspect each view, and edges forward for one last searching look.

prompt: pleased. Something small went right and you let yourself enjoy it.
idea: The arm opens into a modest lift, a tiny satisfied nod follows, and the body settles without losing its quiet warmth.

prompt: happy. A friend you like just walked into the room.
idea: The gaze lifts in recognition, the arm opens toward the friend, and a short approach with two buoyant sways settles into a welcoming pose.

prompt: overjoyed. The best possible news just arrived and you can't hold still.
idea: A tight crouch springs into a wide open gasp, quick bounces spill into an exuberant base wiggle, and the arm stays happily raised as the excitement settles.

prompt: a little down. Your plans for the afternoon fell through.
idea: The arm sags modestly as the gaze drops, lingers on the disappointment, and gathers itself only partway.

prompt: sad. You just learned your favourite person is moving far away.
idea: A small reaching lean falters, the arm folds low as the base withdraws and turns away, and the lowered gaze stays with the loss.

prompt: grief-stricken. You sink under a loss that is too heavy to carry.
idea: A brief open-mouthed pause gives way to a deep collapse, a failed attempt to rise, and small sobbing heaves that subside without lifting the folded body.

prompt: annoyed. Someone keeps tapping on the table next to you.
idea: The base flicks toward the tapping, the mouth pinches shut, and a sharper second glance ends in a restrained sideways glare.

prompt: angry. Someone knocked over the tower you spent an hour building.
idea: After looking down at the wreckage, the arm rears back and thrusts down and forward with the mouth clamped, arrests in a hard stare, then settles into a tense challenge.

prompt: furious. You are shaking with rage and barely holding it in.
idea: The arm braces tall and wide over planted wheels, the mouth locks shut, and rising tremors force a small pullback that contains the rage.

prompt: uneasy. A noise you can't place comes from the dark hallway.
idea: The base turns toward the hallway while the arm hangs back, a tentative listening lean gives way to a small retreat, and the gaze keeps watch.

prompt: sheepish. You got caught taking the last cookie.
idea: MARS cuts off a tiny chew, tucks its arm and looks away, then steals a hopeful glance back.

prompt: ashamed. You broke a gift someone gave you and they just saw.
idea: MARS glances from the broken gift to its owner, collapses inward and cannot quite bring itself to look up again.

prompt: curious. A strange box appeared on the floor and you want to know what is in it.
idea: MARS perks up, looks down at the box and edges closer, canting its arm as it investigates from another angle.

prompt: intrigued. You hear a faint melody coming from behind a door.
idea: MARS pauses with an inquisitive cant, turns toward the door and leans closer before catching a little of the melody's sway.

prompt: fascinated. A butterfly lands on your arm and you study it closely.
idea: MARS holds its raised arm almost still, parts its gripper in wonder and studies the butterfly with tiny changes of gaze.

prompt: bored. The same commercial has been playing for twenty minutes.
idea: MARS slouches and fidgets, looks away, then briefly perks toward the screen before sagging again.

prompt: deeply bored. You have been waiting at the station for hours with nothing to do.
idea: MARS looks around listlessly, lifts out of its slouch for a wide yawn and folds back down into a heavy, lopsided wait.

prompt: nervous. You are about to speak in front of a crowd.
idea: MARS faces the audience with its arm tucked, fidgets through a false start and finally edges forward with a tentative open mouth.

prompt: anxious. You keep checking the door for someone who is very late.
idea: MARS keeps turning back to the same door, rocks with impatience and inches toward it before settling into a tense watch.

prompt: content. You are warm, charged and the afternoon is quiet.
idea: MARS relaxes into an open posture with a small, slow rise and fall and a softly parted gripper.

prompt: searching for a lost sock. You look under everything.
idea: MARS folds low to scan beneath one spot, then pulls clear and turns for two progressively deeper peeks.

prompt: interrupted mid-task. Someone calls you while you are busy.
idea: MARS stops its busy forward strokes mid-pose, lifts its gaze first, then turns its body toward the caller and listens.

prompt: refusing an unsafe request. You won't climb onto the table.
idea: MARS looks up at the table, clamps its mouth, backs away, and gives two firm side-to-side base shakes before holding a square stance.

prompt: ready for instructions. You wait eagerly for your next job.
idea: MARS raises its gaze, perks its arm open, and edges closer with two small forward pulses before holding an eager listening posture.

prompt: low battery. Your energy drains and you slow down.
idea: MARS's arm pulses grow smaller and slower as its posture folds inward, its gaze sinks, and the last of its energy drains into a near-still droop.

prompt: booting up. You come online piece by piece.
idea: From a folded inactive pose, MARS wakes its gaze, tests its mouth, raises and opens its arm, then checks its base and faces forward alertly.

prompt: fully charged. You are bursting with energy again.
idea: MARS coils low, springs tall and wide with a gaping mouth, then rolls forward into buoyant bobs and one last lift before settling proudly.

prompt: processing a hard request. You crunch the numbers.
idea: MARS folds inward and counts with small mouth pulses, tightens at a sticking point, then crunches faster before settling into quiet concentration.

prompt: confused. The instructions you were given contradict each other.
idea: MARS leans into one interpretation, recoils into the opposite cant, then opens its arm in a baffled, unfinished shrug.

prompt: relieved. The vase wobbled but did not fall.
idea: MARS freezes mid-reach, then drops its raised arm in a relieved exhale and looks up again.

prompt: a big cough. You gather a breath, hold it, then cough hard twice.
idea: MARS lifts and draws back for a breath, clamps its mouth to hold it, then folds forward in two hard coughs and slowly straightens.

prompt: clearing your throat. You get ready to make an important announcement.
idea: MARS turns slightly aside for two small throat pulses, then squares up tall and parts its mouth to address the room.

prompt: a hiccup fit. Little jolts keep catching you between breaths.
idea: MARS repeatedly eases into a breath only to jerk upward and backward with its mouth snapping shut at uneven intervals.

prompt: bursting out laughing. A joke builds slowly and then the punchline lands.
idea: MARS slowly lifts and draws back to contain a laugh, then bursts wide and folds forward into bouncing laughter that dwindles to a last chuckle.

prompt: agreeing. You keep agreeing with small eager nods as someone explains the plan.
idea: MARS leans toward the speaker with brisk little nods, edges closer, and nods faster before settling into attentive agreement.

prompt: uh-huh. You listen and give little nods of encouragement.
idea: MARS holds a gentle listening lean, giving two tiny nods and a later single nod of encouragement.

prompt: refusing. You firmly turn away from an offer you don't want.
idea: MARS clamps its mouth, tucks its arm and backs away, then turns aside and holds its refusal upright.

prompt: not that one. You turn side to side looking unconvinced at each option.
idea: MARS inspects each side, pulls back from both options with its mouth tight, and ends with a small shake of its base.

prompt: thanking someone. They helped you out of a tight spot.
idea: MARS opens from a tense tuck, edges closer, and holds a grateful forward bow before lifting its gaze.

prompt: you're welcome. Someone thanks you and you are glad to help.
idea: MARS opens comfortably, gives an easy nod, and rocks with quiet pleasure while remaining available.

prompt: comforting someone. Your friend is crying and you stay close and gentle.
idea: MARS lowers its open posture, rolls gently closer, and gives two tiny listening nods before staying close and attentive.

prompt: encouraging someone. You cheer them on before a hard exam.
idea: MARS crouches briefly, springs tall and open toward its friend, and delivers three confident nods before holding a supportive stance.

prompt: teasing playfully. You pretend not to give back their phone.
idea: MARS twice leans forward in a false offer, snaps its arm back out of reach, and ends with amused chatter and a softer lean.

prompt: telling a joke. You build up to the punchline and wait for the laugh.
idea: MARS leans in to chatter, draws tall and back for suspense, then snaps forward with the punchline and waits expectantly.

prompt: being ignored. You say something and nobody looks at you.
idea: MARS speaks with an eager lean, pauses for a response, then searches slightly to one side and shrinks in uncertainty.

prompt: ignored again. You try a second time to get attention, then give up.
idea: MARS gathers itself for a taller, louder appeal, waits in vain, then folds low and rolls away with its gaze down.

prompt: complimented. Someone says you did a wonderful job.
idea: MARS recoils with a small gasp, dips bashfully, then blossoms tall and open with a pleased little sway.

prompt: being scolded. Someone is upset with you and you take it quietly.
idea: MARS folds inward with its mouth closed, keeps its gaze lowered, and answers with one small, subdued nod.

prompt: pleased, a small nod. The cup was placed exactly where it belongs.
idea: MARS checks the cup, gives one neat little nod, and settles slightly taller and open.

prompt: nailed it. You caught the falling object at the last moment.
idea: MARS recoils upward, snaps down to catch and clamp, then draws the catch close before rising proudly.

prompt: failing a task. The object slipped out of your gripper again.
idea: MARS snaps after the slipping object, closes on empty air, then folds low and gives two frustrated little base shakes.

prompt: deflated. You tried your best and it still didn't work.
idea: MARS waits in tentative hope, lets its arm collapse inward, and slowly sinks behind its lowered gaze.

prompt: trying again. You shake off a failure and set up for another attempt.
idea: MARS shakes its folded posture loose, straightens with a clamped mouth, and steps into a focused working stance.

prompt: asking for help. The lid is too tight and you need someone.
idea: MARS gives two strained tugs, then turns toward someone with an upturned gaze, a canted arm, and a small pleading chatter.

prompt: offering something. You hold out a cookie to a guest.
idea: MARS checks the cookie, extends its arm with a small welcoming step, and keeps the offer steady while looking at the guest.

prompt: presenting your work. You show off the drawing you made.
idea: MARS gathers the drawing close, opens tall in a proud reveal, and turns gently to display it before holding the pose.

prompt: noticing a person. Someone quietly stands in the doorway.
idea: MARS interrupts its downward attention, turns its base toward the doorway, and opens slightly as it recognizes the person.

prompt: spotting a mess. You notice crumbs all over the floor.
idea: MARS recoils with a small gasp, then leans over and scans the scattered crumbs while keeping its gaze on the floor.

prompt: waiting for an answer. You asked a question and they are taking their time.
idea: MARS holds its mouth almost shut and its gaze on the person, leaning farther in before making two tiny, patient shifts.

prompt: excited to share news. You can't wait to tell someone what happened.
idea: MARS bunches up, springs open toward the person, and chatters in two eager bursts before settling into an attentive lean.

prompt: I don't know. You genuinely have no idea.
idea: MARS glances aside, lifts into a lopsided open shrug, and leaves its mouth slightly open as the shrug subsides.

prompt: oops. You made a small, harmless mistake.
idea: MARS gives a tiny open-mouthed recoil, folds into a sheepish sideways tuck, then looks back up with a small recovery.

prompt: surprised by a question. Nobody has asked you that before.
idea: MARS recoils upright with a wide-open mouth, pauses, then partly closes its mouth and leans in with a questioning cant.

prompt: saying goodbye. A friend is leaving after a nice visit.
idea: MARS turns after its friend, raises its arm into three loose farewell waves, and lowers it while continuing to watch them leave.

prompt: see you tomorrow. Your person heads to bed.
idea: MARS offers a warm upward gaze and a reassuring nod, then makes a little room and watches its person head to bed.

prompt: a reluctant farewell. You don't want them to go.
idea: MARS reaches after its person, starts to withdraw, reaches again with a small following step, then slowly gives in and droops.

prompt: good night. The lights are going off and you settle down.
idea: MARS lets its gaze droop, opens into a small sleepy stretch and yawn, then folds low and settles almost motionless.

prompt: celebrating a completed task. You just finished tidying the whole room.
idea: MARS surveys the tidy room, crouches, bursts tall and open with three jubilant bobs, then holds a proud finished posture.

prompt: got it! You finally understand what they meant.
idea: The tucked, canted arm snaps tall and open as the gaze lifts, then a crisp nod seals the realization.

prompt: politely disagreeing. You don't think that is right but you stay friendly.
idea: An open, attentive posture gives a gentle side-to-side base shake, pauses, and leans warmly back toward the person.

prompt: confused by a question. You don't understand what is being asked.
idea: The arm cants one way and then the other as the body draws inward, leaving the mouth slightly open and the questioning posture unresolved.

prompt: sorry, I didn't catch that. You lean in to hear better.
idea: A small questioning recoil becomes a short step closer and a sustained forward lean with the mouth closed to listen.

prompt: thinking it over. You consider a tricky question before answering.
idea: With its gaze lowered and arm tucked, the robot weighs both sides in a slow sway, then squares up and opens its mouth to answer.

prompt: let me think. You search your memory for an answer.
idea: With its arm tucked and gaze high, the robot turns away, tries a tentative mouth opening, then closes its mouth and searches the other side.

prompt: hmm, interesting. Someone tells you a surprising fact.
idea: A small open-mouthed recoil softens into a canted forward lean and one slow, thoughtful nod.

prompt: explaining something. You walk someone through the steps with emphasis.
idea: The open arm marks three increasingly emphatic forward beats, each prepared by a small lift and pullback and accompanied by gripper chatter.

prompt: apologising. You knocked over a glass and say sorry.
idea: The robot recoils and looks down at the spill, folds inward, then offers a small forward bow and a tentative glance up with a quiet mouth movement.

prompt: a deep apology. You forgot something very important to someone.
idea: A withdrawn acknowledgment gives way to one deep, closed-mouth bow held with weight, followed by a hesitant partial rise that leaves the body low and folded.

prompt: relaxed. Soft music plays and nothing needs doing.
idea: MARS loosens its arm, rocks gently with the music, and settles into an easy backward lean.

prompt: affectionate. A child hugs you goodnight.
idea: MARS opens to the child, folds its arm into the hug, and answers with a small lingering nuzzle.

prompt: tender. You watch over a sleeping kitten curled against you.
idea: MARS lowers its gaze to the kitten, softens into a protective fold, and checks on it with one tiny downward dip.

prompt: embarrassed. Everyone laughed when you bumped into the door frame.
idea: MARS recoils, folds low and turns away, then risks a quick peek before ducking its gaze again.

prompt: flustered. Someone pays you a big compliment in front of everyone.
idea: MARS pops up in surprise, wobbles bashfully aside, and turns back with a stumbling little mouth flutter.

prompt: excited. You are about to go to the park.
idea: MARS crouches and springs into eager bounces, edges toward the door, then looks back for the person to come.

prompt: thrilled. The package you waited weeks for is finally at the door.
